name: Fauvism and Early Expressionism
intro: From the Paris painters nicknamed the wild beasts to the groups in Dresden, Munich and Vienna who took colour, line and paint to the edge. Each picture shows one thing to look for.
homeDescription: How to recognize Fauvism and early Expressionism, from Matisse and Derain to Kirchner, Kandinsky, Marc and Schiele, in a short illustrated guide.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing Fauvism and early Expressionism in France, Germany and Austria, 1905 to 1915, compiled from museum collection records.
